title: Trajectory Secures $45M Series A to Help Nontechnical Users Post-Train AI Models
summary:
A new AI tool has hit the market that allows professionals such as doctors and lawyers to customize the behavior of large language models without needing a background in computer science. The startup behind the tool, Trajectory, brought its total capital to $60M following a recent $45M Series A round led by Sequoia that valued the company at $300M. The lauch focuses on a self-serve platform that handles the training, evaluation, and deployment of trillion parameter models using a user's own production data and as few as five lines of code.

As part of the release, Trajectory introduced two research previews: a tool called Continual Grading to help scale human preference standards, and a new algorithm, GS1, that allows models to learn directly from their activity in production. The company says these tools are intended to shift the control of model behavior and quality definitions away from a handful of AI labs and into the hands of the individual users.

selectedTweets.text:
Imagine if everyone had the tools to shape intelligence itself. That day is today.

Today we launch the Trajectory platform - the easiest and most intuitive tool to post-train models of your own. The foundation for continual learning.

With just a few agent prompts, you get access to a full creative suite to train, eval, and deploy trillion parameter models.

On top of that, we believe in a future where you don’t just shape your model once, it also keeps learning on its own from the world around it.

We’re releasing two research previews.

1. Continual grading scales your taste, so your model learns what good looks like from far more than you could ever grade by hand.
2. GS1, a new algorithm that lets models learn directly from what they do in production.

We’ve now raised 60M, with a new round led by @Sequoia at a 300M valuation to democratize the most powerful technology of today - training models - so that the lawyers, doctors, and engineers of the world can own their own intelligence.

You know what good looks like, now go build it. Own your own value function with Trajectory.
